During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''Clone Sergeants''' were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] bred on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to command [[Squad/Legends|squads]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], as well as [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] of the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]].

==Equipment==
{{Quote|That gear's just going to get splattered again as soon as we step off. You know that, right?''"<br />"''Is that supposed to be funny?''"<br />"''A little. You've been trying to rub the ''white'' off that helmet since we left HQ. But you're right&mdash;it's probably a little out of line, too&hellip; {{'}}''Sergeant'' Shiny' would be the more ''appropriate'' designation.|[[Syke (clone trooper)|Syke]] and [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with olive green markings on their helmets and torso at the beginning of the Clone Wars. Some clone trooper sergeants didn't have green flashes on their battle armor. Such troopers included the sergeant aiding in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] search for [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] after the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], as well as two unmarked clone sergeants participating in the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]] and in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].

==Rank==
As one of the non-commissioned [[Officer/Legends|officer]] ranks in the Grand Army, clone sergeants were in the thick of battle along with the troops under their command. They commanded squads of nine clone troopers. [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone lieutenants]] coordinated the squads under the sergeants' command into [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

===ARC trooper sergeants===
The rank of sergeant was also applied to [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] as a ranking of unknown command placement. These ARC sergeants also bore green markings. The most notable of these sergeants was [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[A'den Skirata|Null-12]], nicknamed A'den.<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> Another ARC sergeant operated with Anakin Skywalker during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]], during an attempt to free hostages.
